description: This file contains utility functions for mapping statuses and strings to color values in a consistent, theme-aware manner, primarily for use in data visualization components. It defines functions for deterministic color generation from strings and status-to-color mapping based on known statuses, with support for dark backgrounds.

methods.name: colorFromString(key, { saturation = 55, lightness = 55 } = {})
methods.description: Deterministically generates a pastel-like HSL color string from an input string, producing distinct hues for different inputs while maintaining consistent saturation and lightness.

methods.name: getStatusColor(status, oc)
methods.description: Maps a status string to a specific color based on predefined mappings, or generates a deterministic color if the status is unknown or custom.
